experiment_layer: P0 label preparation; exploratory materials preparation only
research_question: Given a table pair extracted from a reference JOIN, can two independent reviewers agree on the accepted set of valid FK mappings well enough to evaluate a frozen G-reasoner Accepted@1 pilot?
core_hypothesis: The frozen, identity-stable candidate pool can support 60 unique question-table-pair review units with blinded A/B ordering and enough cross-review agreement to make a small mapping-ranking pilot evaluable.
success_criteria_for_material_preparatio: All five frozen input hashes match
Exactly 60 unique full question-table-pair units after a disjoint 5-question preparation smoke
At least three anonymous databases in Full
A/B case and candidate mapping sets match exactly
A/B display order differs and complete FK column-pair mappings are preserved
Gold SQL, question IDs, database IDs, source labels, and model ranks are absent from reviewer packets
Private files are mode 0600 and directories are mode 0700
stop_conditions: Any frozen input hash or candidate census mismatch
Fewer than 60 unique eligible questions after the separate 5-question smoke
Fewer than three databases in Full
Privacy scan or private file permission failure
data_source: BIRD dev (repeatedly used development/diagnostic data, not an independent test set)
sample_unit: One question and one unordered endpoint table pair with at least two distinct complete valid FK mappings; at most one pair per question
